correctness.rationale: Exterior multiplication yields independent conditions v_i wedge v_j=0 and <v_i,w_j>-<v_j,w_i>=0 over odd characteristic. The first is rank<=1 determinantal locus in 4×m columns; nonzero rank-one base dimension m+3 and each cubic-coordinate fiber dimension 3m+1, plus 8m central even parameters, give 12m+4 and irreducibility. Every zero-v point arises in an actual rank-one degeneration by choosing v with nonzero (<v,w_i>) vector (or arbitrary nonzero t if all zero). Smoothness on nonzero rank stratum follows from locally trivial linear fibers. At zero-v points, actual deformations and polarization show reduced tangent directions of dimension 4m+tau(r,m), tau=r(r+1)/2+m(4-r)>4 for all admissible m,r; adding free even gives tangent dimension above local 12m+4. Finite-field zero rank and nonzero rank-one counts give the polynomial. In char2 graded signs disappear so algebra is commutative. Independent exact finite-field matrix rank checks verified tau for 34 combinations, not unrestricted proof. Source verifier code builds original wedge products and finite-field counts; its historical log alone was not treated as scientific proof.

final_claim: For the 16-dimensional exterior algebra on exactly four generators, every reduced commuting-m-tuple variety (m>=2) in odd characteristic is irreducible of dimension 12m+4, smooth precisely when some tuple entry has a nonzero degree-one part, with singular linear locus of dimension 12m. Every odd-q finite-field tuple count has the stated q^{8m}[q^{4m}+(q^4-1)/(q-1)*(q^m-1)q^{3m+1}] formula, adjoint ranks 0,1,4; in characteristic two the variety is A^{16m}.
limitations: Exterior algebra on exactly four generators; arbitrary base field, but geometry in odd characteristic and separate char2.
